classification: post-hoc 10% C satellite-cap portfolio with monthly gold 200-day trend proxy; full cost, concentration, plateau, robustness and fresh-start validation

gold_proxy.rule: monthly close > 200-day MA uses gold; otherwise 50/50 treasury+dividend

limits: The gold trend rule and 10% C cap are post-hoc.
Common window starts in 2023; not a full 2018-2026 validation.
Gold, treasury and dividend ETF qfq series are not official PIT total-return benchmarks.
The proxy does not model intraday execution or ETF premium/discount.
